treatments.title: Dental Cleaning & Polishing
treatments.description: Removes plaque, tartar, and surface stains to support gum health and fresher breath.
treatments.details: The doctor checks your gums and teeth, removes buildup with dental instruments, and polishes the tooth surfaces. Regular cleaning can reduce gum irritation and make daily brushing more effective.

treatments.title: Root Canal Treatment
treatments.description: Cleans and seals an infected tooth so the natural tooth can often be saved.
treatments.goodFor: Deep decay, severe pain, infected pulp
treatments.details: After examination and X-ray guidance when needed, the infected inner portion of the tooth is cleaned, shaped, disinfected, and sealed. A crown may be recommended afterward for long-term strength.

treatments.title: Dental Fillings
treatments.description: Repairs a decayed or damaged area with a suitable restorative material.
treatments.goodFor: Small cavities, chipped areas, early decay
treatments.details: The affected area is cleaned and restored with tooth-colored or suitable filling material. Early fillings can help prevent decay from becoming deeper and more painful.

treatments.title: Crowns & Bridges
treatments.description: Protects weak teeth and replaces missing teeth to restore bite strength and smile balance.
treatments.goodFor: Post-root-canal teeth, damaged teeth, missing teeth
treatments.details: A crown covers and protects a weak tooth. A bridge uses neighboring support to replace a missing tooth. The doctor explains material choices, appointments, and care instructions.

treatments.title: Tooth Extraction
treatments.description: Removes teeth that cannot be restored or may affect surrounding oral health.
treatments.details: Extraction is recommended only after assessing whether the tooth can be saved. The visit includes local anesthesia, careful removal, and after-care guidance for healing.

treatments.title: Teeth Whitening
treatments.description: Brightens teeth by reducing stains and discoloration under dental supervision.
treatments.details: The doctor first checks for cavities, gum concerns, and sensitivity risk. Whitening options and expectations are explained so the result looks natural and comfortable.

treatments.title: Children's Dentistry
treatments.description: Supports child hygiene, cavity care, brushing habits, fluoride guidance, and milk-tooth concerns.
treatments.goodFor: Kids, first visits, cavities, habit guidance
treatments.details: Children are guided gently through checkups and preventive care. Parents receive practical advice on brushing, diet, habits, and when a tooth needs treatment.

treatments.title: Dentures
treatments.description: Replaces missing teeth with removable or fixed options for better chewing, speech, and appearance.
treatments.details: The clinic reviews your gums, remaining teeth, bite, and comfort needs before suggesting partial or complete denture options and follow-up adjustments.

faqs.question: How often should I visit the dentist?
faqs.answer: Most people should book a routine dental checkup every 6 months. If you have active dental issues, the doctor may recommend more frequent visits.

faqs.question: Is professional teeth whitening safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, when performed under dental supervision. The doctor checks your oral health first and explains sensitivity care.

faqs.question: Can I walk in?
faqs.answer: Appointments are recommended so waiting time is lower and the doctor can plan enough time for your concern.

faqs.question: What happens during the first visit?
faqs.answer: Your medical and dental history are reviewed, followed by an oral examination. X-rays may be suggested if needed for diagnosis.

faqs.question: What payment modes are available?
faqs.answer: You can pay by UPI apps such as Google Pay or PhonePe, or by cash at the clinic.
